publication_policy: Noether is already at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Do not loose-upload this micro-package. Fold it into a deliberate compact Noether current-control/source-audit rebalance that fronts reader PDFs and current TeX first.

packages.scope: German cumulative current-control package after Web R268 and the latest LocalCodex fix-bearing carry-forward work.
packages.base: Web R268 cumulative plus latest LocalCodex P06/P08/P09 source-certain carry-forward package.
packages.reader_surface: Contains cum_de_R269.tex and cum_de_R269.pdf; PDF_CHECKS_R269.json reports a 471-page cumulative PDF.
packages.source_witness: Includes source witnesses/renders for Paper 06 source pp.164, 166, 167, 174, 178, 185; Paper 08 source p.98; and Paper 09 source pp.112, 124, plus no-fix/source-trap ledgers.
packages.result: Promotes ten source-certain German replacements across Papers 06, 08, and 09 on top of Web R268. It also carries unchanged-span guards for P13, P15, P16, P17, P19, P21, P22, P30, P35, P36, P43, and the post-P43 tail.
packages.not_promoted: P09 p111 extra 'ist' row remains a no-fix trap with available witnesses. Latest local P11 page-audit package was no-patch and is not promoted into TeX in this pass.
packages.caveat: Current-control/source-certain patch layer only. This is not whole-Noether closure, not paper-by-paper certification, not multilingual synchronization, not critical-edition material, and not a reason to claim the Noether corpus is fully source-faithful.

packages.scope: Post-Web-R269 LocalCodex handoff wrapper containing the byte-identical R269 German cumulative plus LocalCodex audit/disposition ledgers that were not inside the shorter R269 package.
packages.base: Web R269 cum_de_R269.tex is reported byte-identical to LocalCodex cum_de_after_WebR268_plus_LocalP06_P08P09_sourcecertain.tex.
packages.result: No new TeX patch beyond Web R269. Adds P02-P43 closure/survival/no-fix-trap ledgers, especially P23-P24, P25-P28, P29-P30, P31-P36, and P37-P43 tail survival/no-fix-trap checks.
packages.important_no_fix_trap: The Cyrillic block immediately before Paper 36 is source-backed Russian resume material at the end of Paper 35 and should not be deleted as InterSlavic/Russian contamination.
packages.still_not_certified: P30, P40, P41, P42, and parts of the P37-P43 tail remain best-available/source-limited rather than strict 650+ dpi certification. The package is audit/disposition evidence, not global page-by-page source certification.
packages.publication_note: Prefer this wrapper as the compact handoff/context package when rebasing future Noether work, because it contains R269 plus the local audit closures missing from the shorter R269 ZIP.

public_summary: 2026-06-29 Noether R269 local carry-merge: a compact German current-control package that absorbs ten source-certain P06/P08/P09 fixes on top of Web R268 and compiles to a 471-page cumulative German PDF. A later 5.5 MB LocalCodex wrapper adds P02-P43 closure/survival/no-fix-trap ledgers without changing the TeX. These should be folded into the next Noether rebalance, not loose-uploaded above reader/current-TeX surfaces.
